QorCap v0.3.40: Start Match encoding and heartbeat gaps

`receipt.v0.json` is unchanged.

- `start-match.ps1` is UTF-8 with a BOM so Windows PowerShell 5.1 parses the QORCAP / QORTIME cards. Shipped `.ps1` files are pure ASCII or carry that BOM.
- `inputs.jsonl` `hb` rows add `max_rx_gap_us`, `stale_over_50ms`, `short_reads`, `parse_faults`, and `first_rx_t_us`, reset every heartbeat, so a stall that recovers inside the interval stays visible. `dev_counter` is a diagnostic raw report byte with unvalidated semantics. Epoch increments on every HID handle open and on a device identity change, and stale telemetry resets on reconnect. The row is a heartbeat for pad-link continuity (skill-proof join), not identity/anti-cheat. Existing input record types are unchanged.
